explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 42 named tracks and releases across July–September 2026 current windows, adjacent/emerging club music and overlooked 2014–2025 catalogue reviews; metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: All canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits and previously retained exact identities were excluded.
Tumbadora was excluded as a prior unresolved research lead; no materially new identity evidence justified a retry.
The two listener-protected internal trio handoffs remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and all other boundaries are not protected by implication.

Release-level context was allowed to establish credible contender status under the repaired Scout floor, but never treated as proof of exact-track energy, density, phrase structure, mixability or successful placement.
No lead count or ADD quota was targeted; eight honest contenders survived the scan.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Valesuchi — Amor: strongest structural contender because exact evidence documents harsh machine sounds yielding to hand-drum rhythms, with a plausible late-middle consolidation function.

2. Shez Kurx — Selecta: strongest current adjacent-world contender; compact UKG/hardgroove/techno context could sharpen the open threshold before the protected trio, though exact behaviour is sparsely documented.
3. Nuel — Ballet: strongest boundary-scale alternative; exact drum-free polyrhythmic propulsion could form an overture or afterword without being forced into the central run.
4. GRCA. — SALVADOR: current slow-burn contender with delicate structures orbiting bass, plausible as an early widening or afterword.
5. Wata Igarashi — The Sailage: exact syncopated-kick/arpeggio construction offers a controlled internal redirection.
6. Maara — I Wish You Would: subtle syncopation and tribal percussion provide an adjacent-world early or tail possibility.

7. Sounds of Future Siam — Windmill: syncopated full-step dubstep with Thai instrumentation supplies a conspicuous different-world option, ranked lower because techno identity and handoffs are less certain.
8. Lucy — Sana Sana Sana Cura Cura Cura: explicit cross-rhythms strongly fit the lens, but current journey function is less distinct from already-retained central mechanisms.
